parts.stem: Put the steps for taking your pulse in the correct order.

items.value: Take the pulse using the artery in your wrist or the artery in your neck.
Rest for several minutes before taking the pulse.
Count the pulse for a full 60 seconds.

correct_answer: Rest for several minutes before taking the pulse.
Take the pulse using the artery in your wrist or the artery in your neck.
Count the pulse for a full 60 seconds.
